# no-files-without-scenarios

Require a Feature to contain at least one Scenario.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | no | no | none |

Finds Features without any Scenario, including Scenarios under Rules.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-files-without-scenarios": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by
